item.title: Admin Post - Info - Closed
item.content:encoded:
Locking this thread as another exists for the same concept in progress. Reviewers, please comment here: http://www.scpwiki.com/forum/t-13964534/scp-idea

As per the Ideas Critique forum required reading: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-13282684/required-reading:how-to-use-this-forum-ideas Please do not create multiple threads for the same working concept. Using one thread helps keep spam down, and prevents flooding of the forums with repeat threads. Furthermore, it helps reviewers a lot if all corresponding feedback is kept in one place so they can follow the development of the idea and its details.

If you're having trouble getting further replies on a thread, you can look at this thread for options to contact reviewers: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-13282692/how-to-get-more-reviews

item.title: Re: Scp idea
item.content:encoded:
Hi there!
So, first things first: this is way too vague and short to make an in-depth evaluation. You have used not even half of the 400 words limit, so my suggestion is to start fleshing out this idea right here right now. This will make futurw critiques more accurate and helpful.
As a second note, I also suggest investing on the narrative. The format "this is a thing that makes things" was good enough for the first series but now the community want a story rather than a thing that makes things.
In the case of your idea, you can explore this SCP's hatred towards the Foundation, what has it done to warrant it? What has the SCP done against them? How does it get information? Does it know only known facts or can it tell unknown information about the other anomalies? You didn't even tell if the SCP is a human, an animal, a machine or whatever.
This is not a bad idea per se but you have a long way to develop it. Wish you success!

item.title: Scp idea
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: No

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: An scp that knows everything there is know about the foundation, it's object class is: Thaumiel so it must be helpful? Well yes (sometimes) but mostly no, it hates almost everyone in foundation (except for d-class personnel) as he thinks that most of the workers (including the scientists and the O5 council) are "stupid"

Central Narrative: if you bring any scp it will tell them something that they might know (example SCP-682- everyone hates you in the foundation)

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The fact that he knows everything about the scp Foundation
